description: Consommation électriques détaillées des sites des ministères économiques financiers (sept 2017 à sept 2018) is a dataset listed in Open Data du Ministère de l'Économie, des Finances et de la Souveraineté industrielle, énergétique et numérique, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a national body, published or maintained by DAE. Inventaire des sites du parc des Ministères économiques et financiers avec leurs données de consommation annuelles globales, du 1er septembre 2017 au 30 septembre 2018 En pièce jointe, le fichier source de l'inventaire les fichiers de consommation détaillés (« P10 ») au pas de 10 minutes. Coverage: France. The portal files it under ADMINISTRATION. Its keywords are energie, energetique, consommation. The portal shows 86 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2019-12-18 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-economie-gouv-fr-portal.
